ops.note: Mesh fence 155 m (62 panels). Started install 7:15 am, completed 10:30 am. Programme CON WK1 row 59: Perimeter Fence - MBLRS, 155 m, braced every 4th panel. Owner sign-off 16 Oct 2026. Prices and totals blank on the paper.

Mesh fence 262.5 m (105 panels) and CC barrier 302.5 m (121 barriers), 8 wheels. Mesh fence 130 m (52 panels), 6 wheels. Programme EVENT WEEK rows 8 and 64: Residents Fence - Golden Gate East (61 m) and West (31 m), installed ahead of the 19 and 22 Oct dates. Owner sign-off 16 Oct 2026. Prices and totals blank on the paper.
